author: Yffe
content: Failing tests at forge/tests/divergence_rlimit_phrase_drift.rs::{divergence_contract_tv_rlimit_phrases_drifted_from_body_tv, divergence_z3_resourceout_phrase_escapes_contract_tv_rlimit_gate} demonstrate the divergence (run with -- --ignored). contract_tv's phrase set is ["rlimit exceeded", "rlimit) exceeded"]; body_tv's (#189 authority) adds "resource limit exceeded", which is what catches Z3's own resourceout literal 'max. resource limit exceeded' (present in the distributed z3 binary). Fix: add the third clause to contract_tv::is_rlimit_signal, then un-ignore both pins.
